$comment: Crafting consumes MATERIALS and produces permanent gauntlet upgrades. The four recipes and their exact costs and effects are canon, from GDD section 6.1. This replaces the pair-combination 'transmutation' tree entirely: that came from the Unity OrbSystem prototype in the Project_Maelstrom repo, which is a different project from the Unreal game this document describes, and combining two materials into a third is not a Maelstrom mechanic. Canon describes ONE menu holding both crafting and alchemy, and it does not pause the world.
$baseStats_comment: Canon fixes the upgrade amounts but not what they are added to. These base values are INFERRED, not canon - flagged so they can be corrected from the PC build, where the gauntlet gather system already exists. Carry capacity 60 IS canon (section 4.2).

recipes.name: Reinforced Weave
recipes.description: Burl grain laid across vine that already carries its own metal. The gauntlet stops complaining about weight.

recipes.name: Layered Weave
recipes.description: Three materials that have nothing in common except that none of them will give.

recipes.name: Widened Aperture
recipes.description: The mouth of the pull opens wider. You stop having to walk at things.

recipes.name: Deeper Current
recipes.description: The spiral tightens and quickens. Material arrives before you have finished passing it.
